high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Tamil film "Golmaal Again," starring Superstar Rajinikanth. The poster highlights the film's record-breaking success, specifically mentioning that it achieved a worldwide gross collection of 404+ crores (crores being a unit of currency in India) within just four days. Text: At the top, the text reads: "HIGHEST WORLDWIDE GROSS COLLECTION IN THE HISTORY OF TAMIL CINEMA." Below that, the number "404+" is prominently displayed, with "CRORES
